clause: Flattening preview + appearance-of-black + colorize grayscale + channel cross-ref + find/replace color [STU-COL-029,STU-COL-030,STU-COL-014,STU-COL-015]

scope.summary: Bundle the remaining color-management tails: (1) Transparency-flattening preview MUST highlight page areas affected by flattening (rasterized regions, outlined text/strokes) per a flattener preset, as inspectable state ([STU-COL-029]). (2) Appearance-of-black MUST let the document control whether 100% K displays and prints as rich vs accurate black on RGB devices, independently for screen and for export/print ([STU-COL-030]). (3) Channel operations cross-ref: channel/alpha/spot/apply-image/calculations live in 14.4's StudioLayerGraph/StudioMask/channel surface; 14.8 owns only spot-channel-as-StudioSwatch(spot) + the color-mode conversions of [STU-COL-002] — assert no double feature ([STU-COL-014]). (4) Find/replace color MUST find usages of a color and replace with another across objects and text, operating on StudioSwatch/StudioColorProfile references ([STU-COL-015]).
expected_tests: live: flattener-preset flattening preview highlights rasterized/outlined regions; appearance-of-black rich-vs-accurate independent for screen vs export
live: find/replace color across objects+text on StudioSwatch/StudioColorProfile refs
test: channel ops delegated to 14.4 (only spot-as-StudioSwatch + mode-conversion owned here; no double feature)
acceptance_criteria_original: flattening preview (preset); appearance-of-black screen/export split; find/replace color on refs; channel ops delegated to 14.4

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-COL-029] Transparency-flattening preview MUST highlight page areas affected by flattening (rasterized regions, outlined text/strokes) per a flattener preset, as inspectable state (provenance: InDesign Flattener Preview).

[STU-COL-030] Appearance-of-black MUST let the document control whether 100% K displays and prints as rich vs accurate black on RGB devices, independently for screen and for export/print (provenance: InDesign Appearance of Black).

[STU-COL-014] Channel operations (channels panel; alpha/spot channels; duplicate/split/merge channels; apply-image; calculations) are a raster/selection-mask concern deduped into the `StudioLayerGraph`/`StudioMask`/channel surface of 14.4; 14.8 owns only the spot-channel-as-`StudioSwatch(spot)` relation and the color-mode conversions of [STU-COL-002]. This cross-reference prevents a double feature between 14.4 and 14.8.

[STU-COL-015] Find/replace color: Studio MUST support finding usages of a color and replacing them with another across objects and text (provenance: InDesign Find/Change color mode), operating on `StudioSwatch`/`StudioColorProfile` references. --- ### 5. Color Picker / Chooser

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.
